0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The hot-blooded storekeeper and her trusty alpaca gaze at you inquisitively.

24.original: Search for the malodorous coffee bean thief.

25.original: Speak with the malodorous coffee bean thief.

26.original: Retrieve the sack of stolen coffee beans.

27.original: Deliver the sack of stolen coffee beans to the hot-blooded storekeeper.

48.original: Hmm... Interesting. My darling Alpy didn't spit at your approach.

49.original: Which can only mean she trusts you! And if she does, then so do I! As such... I would ask a favor. Recently, a sack of premium coffee beans was stolen from our storehouse.

50.original: The thieves came in the dead of night, but I was wide awake to catch them in the act─a band of Hoobigo mercenaries. My brave Alpy spat on their leader square in the face, and thanks to her saliva's distinctive scent, I was able to track them down.

51.original: They were well armed, however, so I resolved to give up on the coffee beans. But for a strapping <hex:020811E905FF056C616479FF0766656C6C6F7703> like you, contending with those thieves shouldn't be a problem! So please, I beg you─go to Oruncanca, and teach them a lesson!

52.original: You'll find the coffee bean thieves in Oruncanca. Please go there and teach them a lesson!

53.original: <retch> Urgh... The smell! I can't get rid of the smell!

54.original: What!? Who are yo─ <heave> Gah! I've had it up to here today! Boys, get <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>!

56.original: I'm gonna kill you, then that alpaca!

57.original: B-Boys...? Damn you! You'll regret this!

58.original: You're returned! And you look none the worse for wear. What a relief.

59.original: Ah, our precious coffee beans! Thank you so, so much! I knew I could trust you.

60.original: Coffee's popularity continues to soar, as does the demand for it. I'm afraid incidents like this one have grown increasingly more common.

61.original: Everyone's been pouring their hearts into this, to make the most delicious coffee possible and give the mate tea farms a run for their money.

62.original: And yet those thieves tried to steal the very fruit of our labors! Bad apples, the lot of them! And you know a bad apple when you see one, don't you, Alpy? They <hex:021A020203>deserve<hex:021A020103> to be spat on! <ptooey>

63.original: Oh, sorry about that! I got a little carried away. But I've taken up enough of your time. Here─a little something for your troubles. And the spittle...
